sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 ---------
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
For the Petitioner/Applicant: Mr. Arvind Kumar Choudhary, Advocate
For the State: Mr. Anup Pawan Topno, A.P.P.
For O.P. No.2: Mr. J.N. Upadhyay, Advocate
Heard the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Gamharia P.S. Case No. 110 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 498A/323/406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/ 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Seraikella.
3. Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the Bank Account statement, which is annexed, shows that the money is being utilized by the wife.

Further,
there is LIC policy also in the name of the applicant's wife as well as his daughter.
On the above basis, prayer for anticipatory bail has been made.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for opposite party no.2 have opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
It has been submitted that at present the wife is residing with the husband.
5. Considering the nature of dispute and the fact that some cooling period is required, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to surrender in the court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the court below shall enlarge the applicant on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-
(Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Seraikella in connection with Gamharia P.S.
